description: WRITE: adds a webhook to a form, so Wufoo POSTs every new entry to the given URL. Idempotent per URL: calling again with the same URL updates its handshake key / metadata setting instead of adding a duplicate. Forms allow at most 10 integrations. Returns WebHookPutResult.Hash — keep it, it is needed to delete the webhook. Wufoo: PUT /forms/{identifier}/webhooks.json.

form.description: Form identifier: its permanent hash (e.g. s1afea8b1vk0jf7) or its URL title (e.g. wufoo-api-example). See wufoo_list_forms.

handshakeKey.description: Shared secret Wufoo includes in each POST so the receiver can reject unwanted requests.

metadata.description: Include form/field structure in each POST (Wufoo default false).

url.description: The URL Wufoo will POST each new entry to.

name: wufoo_add_webhook
title: Add a webhook
